name: Hoshikawa Tsubasa
source:
Ryou’s classmate and a member of the Firefolk.

He’s such a narcissist that he calls himself handsome.

It can be hard to tell when he’s joking, drawing ire from those around him at times.

He’s a talented fencer and wields a sword in battle.

His ability is Keen Eye, granting him superhuman dynamic visual acuity and the power to find the weak points in objects.

His weapon is a rapier called Saint-Exupery.

(from Kagura Games' website)
